h1: AI UGC Video Ads Generator: Scroll-Stopping Ads From a Photo or Link
lead: A product photo or a product page can still become a spoken ad. AIVideosUGC builds it with a script, an AI actor, a voice, and captions.

definition.title: What Is an AI UGC Video Ad?
paras: It is a short spoken ad built from a photo you already use, a short note, or a product page. You skip the filming, the separate editor, and the crew.
Export 9:16 when the buy is a phone placement, or 1:1 for a square feed. 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4 are available too.

steps.t: Add a Link or a Photo

The actor says the kettle whistles at a boil. Change that sentence when your steel is different, then keep the take.
Download the 9:16 kettle ad, or send it from this screen when the ad account is the one that will spend.

faq.q: What does an AI ad generator produce?
faq.a: A spoken ad from a product photo or a product page, with a script, an AI actor, and a voice. You do not film a set.

faq.q: How does a shop build an ad here?
faq.a: Start with a product photo or a page. Approve the drafted sentence, change a word when the product differs, then download the ad.

faq.q: When is this the right tool for ads?
faq.a: Use it when many products each need an ad you can test. A single filmed hero is a different job.

faq.q: Do I pay credits for each ad?
faq.a: Yes. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. Six seconds uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 uses 60, and 30 uses 120. You see the number before it runs.

faq.q: Can I run the clips as paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. The clip on a paid plan can be the ad you fund. The file has no watermark.

faq.q: Which frames and networks are supported?
faq.a: Phone buys want 9:16, and a square feed wants 1:1. 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4 are there when the placement asks. You can send the file from this screen.

faq.q: Can I make an ad for every product at once?
faq.a: Yes. Each product can get an ad from its own photo.

faq.q: How do these compare with ads filmed by creators?
faq.a: Book a creator when you need a person filmed with the product itself. Use the generated ad when you are still choosing which opening to buy.

faq.q: What should I check before a network runs this ad?
faq.a: Read that ad account's current rule before you fund the clip. If a viewer could think a buyer filmed their own product, add the label that account asks for.
Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, so one action has a clear start and end.

faq.q: Can I change captions, the voice, or the music?
faq.a: Yes. Captions are written with the script, and you can edit them. Swap the voice, pick a track from the music library, or add music you have rights to, before you post.

faq.q: Can my shop software request ads through an API?
faq.a: Yes. Your own tool can ask for an ad from each product on the list. Every clip still spends credits.

faq.q: Who is the person on screen?
faq.a: An AI actor. Do not present the clip as a buyer filming a review of an order they received. Add the label the ad account asks for, and keep the scene true to the product.

steps.sourceAlt: Your product: an insulated bottle shown alone on a pure white background.
steps.prompt: Use your product photo and keep its shape, color and label the same. Show one person using the product in a familiar place, then hold it up clearly. Light it like a phone video and keep the camera steady. Keep the sound of the action and the room. No words, logos or music.
